values.note: The 20 camping units are first-come, first-served; only the day-use picnic shelter is listed on recreation.gov. Limit 8 people and 2 vehicles per unit.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/256935 ('There are 20 camping units available on a first-come, first-served basis.'; 'FEE: $5 per unit, per night (limit of 8 people and 2 vehicles per unit)'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raven-cliff-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: Mid - April - Late November'), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raven-cliff-recreation-area ('$5 per site per night. Day use is free.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/256935 ('FEE: $5 per unit, per night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Each unit has a gravel parking spur, picnic table and fire grill; 'Recreation vehicles up to 25 feet long can be accommodated in some sites.' Some sites have a pad for tents or pop-ups.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/256935 ('There are 20 camping units ... Each unit has a gravel parking spur, picnic table and fire grill. Some sites have a pad for tents or pop-up trailers. Recreation vehicles up to 25 feet long can be accommodated in some sites.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Portable toilets and garbage cans in the campground; vault toilets at the picnic shelter. No drinking water: bring your own.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/256935 (notices 'There is no drinking water available, you must bring your own.', 'No flush toilets available, only porta-john toilets. Vault toilets are available at the picnic shelter area.'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS campground (Mount Rogers NRA) in the mountains of southwest VA, by Cripple Creek (fishing, wading, tubing at the picnic area); no specific water body confirmed at the sites. Unstaffed. Hurricane Helene damage: the Raven Cliff Furnace Trail (4616) and Raven Cliff Trail (4601) are closed and the bridge to the furnace is gone (recreation.gov notice, 2026-10). --Claude
summary: Read the Forest Service page and recreation.gov 256935: confirmed 20 first-come units, $5/night, not reservable; added RVs to 25 ft in some sites, season mid-April to late November, no flush toilets (portable only), no drinking water. Note: dropped the RV Life line (in rating) and the FCFS sentence (in booking), added the Helene trail closures.
flags: Phone missing: the managing Mount Rogers NRA office (Pat Jennings Visitor Center) is 276-783-5196 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raven-cliff-recreation-area); the site itself is unstaffed.
